title: dirt=diamonds
description: This project aims to make assend diamond dupers to the godly plane, this simple datapack makes puting 1 dirt in a crafting table fill your inventory with diamonds. needs to be installed on world
body:
This datapack is simple, place one dirt the middle of a crafting table and get 64 diamonds, then place the 64 back in and your whole inventory is filled.

The datapack is super lightwieght and has 0 impact on preformance. 
remember to put downloaded data pack here (https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5346d3dc6ee0255cec19ce3e71dd654f6709d12a_0.webp)
